title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Niger, ICSP improved community and district‑level health systems by strengthening linkages between health services, local governance bodies and community structures such as Village Development Committees and women’s groups. Communities became more proactive in adopting positive health and nutrition practices, reducing their vulnerability to climate and disease‑related shocks. Health‑related preparedness advanced through stronger coordination with local authorities and technical services, enabling quicker surveillance, earlier alerts and more organised mobilisation during seasonal epidemics and flooding. These combined efforts supported more predictable, locally led responses to health‑related crises.. GOAL focuses on health system strengthening with the objective of increasing the number and percentage of health facilities providing quality health services (including nutrition services and WASH facilities), so that health and well-being can improve.
